smartExpand.title: Smart Expand
smartExpand.description: Select any node and click "Smart Expand". AI will automatically analyze the node content and generate related child nodes. Supports background batch processing, ideal for quickly building knowledge systems.

autoQuestion.title: Auto Generate Questions
autoQuestion.description: AI can automatically generate various types of review cards including single-choice, multiple-choice, and Q&A based on node content, and automatically add them to the FSRS memory algorithm review queue.
